Caddy has no certificate for the face names yet, so the handshake fails before anything reaches your box. Your DNS and the connection are fine.
The bare face.spirit.andyflinn.com will stay like this for now. It is no name, so the face refuses it a certificate (the bare page is still an open item). Test join.face.spirit.andyflinn.com instead.
Run these on spirit-3 and paste me the output:
1) grep -n on_demand /etc/caddy/Caddyfile; caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
2) curl -s -w '%{http_code}\n' 'http://127.0.0.1:65434/.well-known/spirit-name?domain=join.face.spirit.andyflinn.com'   (must say 200)
3) journalctl -u caddy -n 50 --no-pager | grep -iE 'on.demand|ask|join.face|certificate|error'
4) journalctl -u spirit-face -n 40 --no-pager
If 1) shows nothing, the global block has not gone in yet, and that is the whole fix.
